title: Servotech Solvion Series On-Grid Solar Inverter 3000W | 1kW to 6kW Range, Wi-Fi & App Control, LCD Display, MPPT 100-500V, Multi-Communication
description: Elevate your residential solar setup with the Servotech Solvion Series On-Grid Solar Inverter, a powerful and intelligent solution engineered for seamless energy conversion. Available in capacities ranging from 1kW to 6kW, this inverter is purpose-built to maximise the performance of your solar power system. The 3kW model delivers a nominal output power of 3000W and a maximum output power of 3300W, with a maximum DC input of 4500W and a peak DC voltage tolerance of 550V. The MPPT voltage range of 100–500V ensures optimal energy harvesting across varying sunlight conditions. Featuring a clear LCD display, the inverter provides real-time system data at a glance. Remote configuration and monitoring are made effortless through intuitive web and app-based platforms with easy-to-read graphics. Versatile connectivity options including Wi-Fi, P2P, LAN, GPRS, and RS485 ensure you stay connected to your system at all times. With a robust design and top-tier performance specifications, the Servotech Solvion Series is a reliable choice for modern solar energy management.
